One reason for dropping the requirement is that study habits and preparation are primarily the responsibility of the educational institution, not the admissions process. Requiring standardized test scores can disproportionately affect students from lower-income backgrounds who may lack access to extensive test preparation resources, thus potentially excluding qualified candidates who might excel once enrolled.
